name: dialog-default
blurb: Self-contained animated dialog with preset styling and profile edit form.
description: A complete DialogDefault component using FramerModal with name and username input fields, animated trigger button with gradient background.
use_when: Quick out-of-the-box dialog component for profile editing with smooth animations and styled UI.
avoid_when: When you need a generic dialog framework — this is a preset with hardcoded form fields.
a11y: Inputs are labeled; form fields are keyboard-navigable; modal closes on Escape or button click; focus management supported.
